fields.about: Kinetic simulations of a collisionless plasma.
fields.overview:
A Vlasov-Poisson solver that measures the Landau damping rate of a Langmuir wave.
The rate is compared with the root of the plasma dispersion relation.
fields.title: Plasma physics

checked.label: program
checked.text: the exact root of the Langmuir dispersion relation for a Maxwellian, from the plasma dispersion function (plasma/landau_check.viv)

checked.label: cases
checked.text: the decks k05 (k lambda_D = 0.5) and k04 (0.4)

plasma.landau.example:
import vipyr as vp
r = vp.plasma.landau(setup="k05")      # k lambda_D = 0.5
print(r.gamma, r.gamma_exact, r.omega)
assert r.check()

examples.code:
import vipyr as vp
r = vp.plasma.landau(setup="k05")      # k lambda_D = 0.5
print(r.gamma, r.gamma_exact, r.omega)
assert r.check()

params.help: the deck: a named set of every parameter's value, with the checks that hold at it
params.name: setup

params.help: grid points in x over one wavelength
params.name: nx

params.help: grid points in v on [-VMAX, VMAX), periodic
params.name: nv

params.help: the velocity grid's edge; 6 VT or more, so the Maxwellian's tail does not wrap around (must be positive)
params.name: vmax

params.help: the electrons' thermal speed, which is also the Debye length in these units (must be positive)
params.name: vt

params.help: the perturbation's wavenumber; the box is 2 pi / K0 (must be positive)
params.name: k

params.help: the relative amplitude of the density perturbation, 1 + ALPHA cos(K0 x); small, so the wave stays linear
params.name: alpha

params.help: the time step, in units of the inverse plasma frequency (must be positive)
params.name: dt

params.help: the run's length, in units of the inverse plasma frequency
params.name: t_end
params.units: units of the inverse plasma frequency

params.help: the fit window's start: late enough that the faster-damped roots of the dispersion relation have died away (each deck says why its value)
params.name: t_fit0

results.doc: the damping rate fitted to the field energy's peaks (negative: damped), in units of the plasma frequency

results.doc: the frequency from the peaks' spacing, in units of the plasma frequency
results.name: omega

results.doc: the imaginary part of the exact Landau root at k lambda_D = K0 VT
results.name: gamma_exact

results.doc: the real part of the exact Landau root
results.name: omega_exact

results.doc: how many field-energy peaks the fit used
results.name: npeaks

results.doc: rms distance of the peaks of log W from the fitted line
results.name: fit_rms

results.doc: the time of each field-energy sample, (n + 1/2) DT
results.name: time

results.doc: the field energy, integral of E^2 / 2 dx, at each TIME
results.name: wfield

results.doc: the largest relative change of the particle count over the run
results.name: mass_drift

results.doc: the relative change of the integral of f^2 over the run
results.name: l2_drift

results.doc: the change of kinetic plus field energy over the run, in units of the initial field energy
